data.narrative:
Fervo Energy is an early-stage geothermal technology company in the Climate & Energy sector preparing for IPO. The comparable universe is sparse: only one public peer (LNZA) and eight private competitors including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. The sector remains nascent and heterogeneous, limiting direct comparability.

Standard peer-median valuation is not applicable here. The Climate & Energy sector contains nine companies total, but filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yields fewer than three datapoints in any single category—below the threshold for reliable triangulation. A broad sector-wide median would conflate companies with fundamentally different business models, technology readiness levels, and capital requirements, introducing substantial noise into valuation estimates.

Given these constraints, valuation of Fervo Energy should rely on revenue multiple analysis (if applicable), discounted cash flow assumptions tied to geothermal project development timelines, and scenario-based assessments of deployment and energy contract pricing. The $1.5B+ raised to date provides a floor reference but does not determine IPO pricing. Key uncertainties include permitting and drilling cost trajectories, power purchase agreement structuring, and whether public market appetite for pre-revenue climate tech persists at entry. Without sufficient peer density, analyst judgment on capital intensity and thermal energy market adoption becomes paramount.
